description.value: The study examined neural correlates of top-down regulation and generation of negative affect in women with major depressive disorder and healthy controls using a cognitive reappraisal fMRI task.

spans.text: The present study was designed to elucidate the neural substrates of these two “top-down” emotion regulation processes in MDD: cognitive reappraisal to reduce and to generate negative affect.
